windows|processor_priority.name: Prioritize foreground programs
windows|processor_priority.on: Gives the program you are using a larger share of processor time

windows|left_align_taskbar_win11.name: Left-align the taskbar
windows|left_align_taskbar_win11.on: Moves the Windows 11 taskbar icons to the left

windows|set_taskbar_left.name: Left-align taskbar icons
windows|set_taskbar_left.on: Moves the Windows 11 taskbar icons to the left

windows|performance_mode.name: Visual effects: adjust for performance
windows|performance_mode.on: Switches visual effects to the 'adjust for best performance' preset

windows|best_performance.name: Turn off all visual effects
windows|best_performance.on: Turns off animations, Aero Peek, thumbnails and other visual effects

gpu|gpu_priority.name: Raise GPU priority
gpu|gpu_priority.on: Sets a higher GPU scheduling preference for applications

gpu|force_multi_gpu.name: Enable multi-GPU rendering
gpu|force_multi_gpu.on: Allows explicit multi-GPU rendering for apps that support it

gpu|gpu_tdr_delay.name: Extend the GPU hang timeout
gpu|gpu_tdr_delay.on: Gives the graphics driver 8 s instead of 2 s before Windows resets it

gpu|set_utc_time.name: Keep the hardware clock in UTC
gpu|set_utc_time.on: Makes Windows read the PC clock as UTC (useful when dual-booting Linux)

power|power_button_action.name: Power button does nothing
power|power_button_action.on: Makes the power button do nothing (plugged in)

power|lid_close_action.name: Closing the lid does nothing
power|lid_close_action.on: Keeps the laptop running when the lid is closed (plugged in)

power|usb_dma.name: Enable DMA protection for USB devices
power|usb_dma.on: Turns on DMA remapping protection for external devices

network|prefer_ipv4.name: Prefer IPv4 over IPv6
network|prefer_ipv4.on: Makes Windows try IPv4 before IPv6 when both work

brave|set_homepage_newtab.name: Brave: use the New Tab page as home
brave|set_homepage_newtab.on: Sets the Brave home page to the New Tab page

brave|set_restore_newtab.name: Brave: open a new tab on startup
brave|set_restore_newtab.on: Makes Brave start with a new tab instead of the last session

brave|apply_all_debloat.name: Brave: apply every debloat setting
brave|apply_all_debloat.on: Applies all the Brave policies on this page at once

personalize|tb_tint.name: Show the accent colour on Start and taskbar
personalize|tb_tint.on: Tints Start, the taskbar and Action Center with the accent colour
personalize|tb_tint.state: Accent colour on Start and taskbar

personalize|dwm_tint.name: Mirror the accent tint to the window manager
personalize|dwm_tint.on: Sets the DWM copy of the accent-tint flag, read by some apps and the lock screen

personalize|taskbar_no_combine.name: Never combine taskbar buttons
personalize|taskbar_no_combine.on: Gives every window its own taskbar button
personalize|taskbar_no_combine.desc: Forces each window to get its own taskbar button (TaskbarGlomLevel = 2).

personalize|clock_seconds.name: Show seconds in the taskbar clock
personalize|clock_seconds.on: Adds seconds to the taskbar clock

personalize|start_recent.name: Show recently opened items in Start
personalize|start_recent.on: Shows recent files in Start and in taskbar jump lists
personalize|start_recent.desc: Shows recently opened items in Start and on the taskbar jump lists (Start_TrackDocs = 1).

personalize|start_frequent.name: Show most used apps in Start
personalize|start_frequent.on: Lists your most used apps at the top of the Start app list
personalize|start_frequent.desc: Shows your most frequently used apps at the top of the app list (Start_TrackProgs = 1).

personalize|desk_thispc.name: Show 'This PC' on the desktop
personalize|desk_thispc.on: Puts the This PC icon on the desktop
personalize|desk_thispc.state: This PC icon on the desktop
personalize|desk_thispc.desc: Shows the 'This PC' icon on the desktop. Applies immediately.

personalize|desk_recyclebin.name: Show the Recycle Bin on the desktop
personalize|desk_recyclebin.on: Puts the Recycle Bin icon on the desktop
personalize|desk_recyclebin.state: Recycle Bin icon on the desktop
personalize|desk_recyclebin.desc: Shows the Recycle Bin icon on the desktop. Applies immediately.

personalize|desk_userfiles.name: Show your user folder on the desktop
personalize|desk_userfiles.on: Puts the user's files folder icon on the desktop
personalize|desk_userfiles.state: User folder icon on the desktop
personalize|desk_userfiles.desc: Shows the 'User's Files' folder icon on the desktop. Applies immediately.

contextmenu|show_more_options.name: Use the classic right-click menu
contextmenu|show_more_options.on: Brings back the full Windows 10 style right-click menu on Windows 11

privacy|feedback_frequency_never.name: Never ask for feedback
privacy|feedback_frequency_never.on: Sets Windows feedback requests to Never

privacy|limit_diagnostic_logs.name: Limit diagnostic log collection
privacy|limit_diagnostic_logs.on: Sets the policy that limits diagnostic log collection

privacy|limit_dump_collection.name: Limit crash-dump collection
privacy|limit_dump_collection.on: Sets the policy that limits crash-dump collection

network|nic_buffers_up.name: Use larger network adapter buffers
network|nic_buffers_up.on: Raises the receive and transmit buffers of the network adapters

network|nic_no_power_off.name: Don't let Windows turn off the network adapter
network|nic_no_power_off.on: Stops Windows switching the adapter off to save power

network|tcp_time_wait_30s.name: Shorten TCP TIME_WAIT to 30 seconds
network|tcp_time_wait_30s.on: Frees closed TCP connections after 30 s instead of 120 s

dns|doh_allow.name: Allow DNS-over-HTTPS
dns|doh_allow.on: Lets Windows upgrade DNS lookups to encrypted DNS-over-HTTPS where the server supports it

dns|negative_cache_off.name: Don't cache failed DNS lookups
dns|negative_cache_off.on: Stops Windows remembering failed DNS lookups

security|uac_always_notify.name: UAC: always notify
security|uac_always_notify.on: Raises User Account Control to its highest level

security|clear_pagefile_at_shutdown.name: Clear the page file at shutdown
security|clear_pagefile_at_shutdown.on: Wipes the page file every time Windows shuts down

debloat|no_driver_search_wu.name: Don't search Windows Update for drivers
debloat|no_driver_search_wu.on: Stops Windows looking for device drivers on Windows Update
debloat|no_driver_search_wu.state: No driver search on Windows Update

debloat|exclude_wu_drivers.name: Exclude drivers from Windows Update
debloat|exclude_wu_drivers.on: Stops Windows Update installing driver updates

debloat|device_metadata_off.name: Don't download device metadata
debloat|device_metadata_off.on: Stops Windows downloading device icons and info from the internet

debloat|lock_screen_off.name: Skip the lock screen
debloat|lock_screen_off.on: Goes straight to the sign-in screen

edge|edge_first_run_off.name: Edge: skip the first-run setup
edge|edge_first_run_off.on: Stops Edge showing its first-run setup pages

edge|edge_desktop_shortcut_off.name: Edge: no desktop shortcut after updates
edge|edge_desktop_shortcut_off.on: Stops Edge updates putting a shortcut back on the desktop

gaming|windowed_game_optimizations.name: Enable optimizations for windowed games
gaming|windowed_game_optimizations.on: Turns on the Windows setting that lowers latency for games in windowed mode

gaming|global_timer_resolution.name: Allow global timer resolution requests
gaming|global_timer_resolution.on: Lets a program's timer resolution request apply system-wide again

cpu|epp_performance_ac.name: Favour CPU performance (plugged in)
cpu|epp_performance_ac.on: Sets the processor energy preference to maximum performance when plugged in

cpu|hybrid_prefer_pcores.name: Hybrid CPUs: prefer performance cores
cpu|hybrid_prefer_pcores.on: Makes Windows schedule work on performance cores first

memory|svchost_grouping.name: Group svchost services
memory|svchost_grouping.on: Runs more services together in shared svchost processes

memory|paging_executive_off.name: Keep the kernel and drivers in RAM
memory|paging_executive_off.on: Stops Windows paging kernel and driver code to disk

storage|ntfs_memory_more.name: Give NTFS more cache memory
storage|ntfs_memory_more.on: Raises the memory NTFS may use for its caches

storage|thumbs_db_network_off.name: No Thumbs.db on network folders
storage|thumbs_db_network_off.on: Stops Windows writing Thumbs.db files to network folders

power|pcie_aspm_off_ac.name: Turn off PCI Express power saving (plugged in)
power|pcie_aspm_off_ac.on: Sets PCI Express link power management to Off when plugged in

usb|usb3_lpm_off_ac.name: Turn off USB 3 power saving (plugged in)
usb|usb3_lpm_off_ac.on: Sets USB 3 link power management to Off when plugged in

usb|keyboard_repeat_fast.name: Shortest key-repeat delay
usb|keyboard_repeat_fast.on: Sets the keyboard repeat delay to its shortest value

responsiveness|mmcss_reserve_10.name: Lower the background CPU reserve to 10 %
responsiveness|mmcss_reserve_10.on: Lowers the CPU share MMCSS keeps for background tasks to 10 %

responsiveness|icon_label_shadow_off.name: No drop shadows on desktop icon labels
responsiveness|icon_label_shadow_off.on: Removes the shadow under desktop icon text

responsiveness|hung_app_timeout_2s.name: Detect 'Not responding' apps sooner
responsiveness|hung_app_timeout_2s.on: Marks a frozen app as not responding after 2 s instead of 5 s

responsiveness|service_kill_timeout_2s.name: Faster shutdown: 2 s service timeout
responsiveness|service_kill_timeout_2s.on: Gives services 2 s to stop at shutdown before Windows ends them

responsiveness|mouse_hover_fast.name: Faster hover tooltips and previews
responsiveness|mouse_hover_fast.on: Shortens the delay before tooltips and previews appear

background|startup_delay_off.name: No delay for startup apps
background|startup_delay_off.on: Starts your startup apps right after sign-in, without the usual wait

background|arso_off.name: Don't auto-sign-in after updates
background|arso_off.on: Stops Windows signing you in automatically to finish updates

background|store_apps_background_off.name: Don't let Store apps run in the background
background|store_apps_background_off.on: Sets the policy that blocks Store apps from running in the background
background|store_apps_background_off.state: Store apps blocked in the background

windows|explorer_open_this_pc.name: Open File Explorer to This PC
windows|explorer_open_this_pc.on: Makes File Explorer open on This PC instead of Home

responsiveness|drag_outline_only.name: Show only an outline while dragging windows
responsiveness|drag_outline_only.on: Drags windows as an outline instead of their full contents

debloat|hide_start_recommended.name: Hide the Start 'Recommended' section
debloat|hide_start_recommended.on: Hides the whole Recommended area of the Windows 11 Start menu

storage|ntfs_8dot3_off.name: Stop creating 8.3 short file names
storage|ntfs_8dot3_off.on: Stops NTFS creating old-style 8.3 short names for new files

gaming|app_capture_off.name: Disable Game Bar captures (your account)
gaming|app_capture_off.on: Turns off Game Bar screenshots and clips for your account

usb|filter_keys_hotkey_off.name: Disable the Filter Keys shortcut
usb|filter_keys_hotkey_off.on: Stops holding Right Shift for 8 s from turning on Filter Keys

usb|toggle_keys_hotkey_off.name: Disable the Toggle Keys shortcut
usb|toggle_keys_hotkey_off.on: Stops holding Num Lock for 5 s from turning on Toggle Keys

windows|disable_sticky_keys.name: Disable the Sticky Keys shortcut
windows|disable_sticky_keys.on: Stops pressing Shift five times from turning on Sticky Keys

security|wsh_off.name: Disable Windows Script Host
security|wsh_off.on: Blocks .vbs and .js scripts run by Windows Script Host

gpu|disable_remote_assist.name: Disable Remote Assistance
gpu|disable_remote_assist.on: Turns off incoming Remote Desktop and Remote Assistance connections

security|remote_assistance_off.name: Block Remote Assistance invitations
security|remote_assistance_off.on: Stops this PC accepting Remote Assistance invitations

windows|copy_details_always.name: Always show file-copy details
windows|copy_details_always.on: Opens the copy dialog with its details view expanded
